verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a public Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains. A probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at developers.cloudflare.com, so the product can be driven programmatically through a documented interface. Missing for 10: detailed per-endpoint documentation in the pack beyond the one-line API summary, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the Registrar API endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
